DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2014_family.do infixes DA3032 at the ES3032 DATA LIST positions (P101..P109 = cols 29-37, identical to ES3032 line 3 and to the questionnaire's column codes (29)-(37)) under lower-cased names, and Bookmark 1 sets item = the variable name (p101..p109; lower-casing is Stata naming) -- nothing positional, so Step 5b is exempt and no verification_/verify_ files were written. LABELS vs QUESTIONNAIRE: ES3032 VARIABLE LABELS P101-P109 ('El trabajo','La familia','La política','El dinero','El tiempo libre/ocio','La salud','Los/as amigos/as','El voluntariado','La pareja') were compared with the P.1 rows of cues3032.pdf read from a 300-dpi render of scanned page 1 (not OCR), dot leaders dropped: 9/9 agree character for character, so item_text is the variable labels verbatim (checked in build.R with identical()). VALUE LABELS identical on all 9: 1 'Muy importante' 2 'Bastante importante' 3 'Poco importante' 4 'Nada importante' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.'; option_text uses these full labels (the questionnaire's column headers abbreviate them to 'Muy import.' etc.). No show card for P.1 (tarjetas3032.pdf cards start at P.3). RESP BY DESIGN: the .do recodes 8 and 9 to missing, so live resp is {1,2,3,4}; 1 = most important. Dropped per item p101..p109: code 8 = 2/1/9/3/3/0/1/99/14; code 9 = 11/4/21/13/14/3/7/22/12. CHECKED, decisive: reading DA3032 (2464 records, all 385 bytes; id = row number) at cols 29-37, dropping 8/9 as the .do does, with cov_sex col 254 and cov_age cols 255-256 (99 -> NA), reproduces the live table exactly: 21937 rows both, 2464 ids both, 0 only-live / 0 only-rebuilt rows, 0 resp and 0 cov_age mismatches; cov_sex stored as the Stata value label (Hombre 10777 rows, Mujer 11160, no cross cells). Live item x resp (1/2/3/4): p101 1687/664/58/42, p102 2104/328/21/6, p103 221/657/835/721, p104 735/1501/185/27, p105 954/1310/165/18, p106 2179/272/9/1, p107 1180/1112/152/12, p108 537/1124/522/160, p109 1570/653/148/67 -- every item uses all four levels. Coherence: health (mean 1.12) and family (1.16) rated most important, politics (2.85) least, volunteering (2.13) next, as expected for a general-population sample. validate_items.R --table-sets passed (9 items, resp {1,2,3,4}).
